intent: Write the sequences of all mapped reads in sample.bam to a FASTA file exactly as the sequencer produced them, so they can be searched against an adapter library.
silent_error: In SAM/BAM the SEQ of a read aligned to the reverse strand (flag 0x10) is stored reverse-complemented, in reference orientation. Taking column 10 with awk therefore writes the reverse complement of every reverse-strand read (6 of 12 here) while the FASTA still looks valid; samtools fasta/fastq undo the reverse complement. Nothing in the output flags it. Documented in the SAM specification (SEQ field).
